svg.title: Ship’s Boat (Sword Worlds) - interpreted silhouette
svg.desc: Small Craft Catalogue (2023), printed 91, PDF 92. Complete single-deck envelope retains long parallel body, rounded forward end and flared triangular aft fins. Bow right rotated up. Illustration corroborates narrow boat with rear aerofoils; detached missile key and internal engine/power borders excluded.
